item.title: North West Performs First Solo Music Festival Set With Support From Ye & Kim Kardashian
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're talking about a rising star in the industry - North West, the 12-year-old daughter of Ye and Kim Kardashian. She just made her debut solo performance at a music festival, and we've got all the details."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of North West's performance]
Host: "On Friday, June 12th, North West took the stage at Lyrical Lemonade's Summer Smash 2026 in Chicago. She performed her 2024 collaboration with Ye, 'TALKING', from his album Vultures 1. And judging by the crowd's reaction, she's definitely got the talent and energy to make it in the music industry."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "North's parents were beaming with pride on social media, with Ye reposting a clip of her performance on his Instagram Stories and Kim Kardashian sharing a photo of backstage passes featuring North's face. Kim also posted a clip of North running onto the festival stage, marking her first-ever festival performance."
[Music transitions to a brief clip of North West's music]
Host: "This performance comes on the heels of North's debut EP, N0rth4evr, which dropped in early May. She's also made appearances on Ye and Ty Dolla $ign's Vultures, as well as FKA twigs' EUSEXUA album. And with her single 'Piercing on My Hand' released in February, it's clear that North West is making waves in the music industry."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "Lyrical Lemonade's Summer Smash 2026 features some big names, including Lil Uzi Vert, Playboi Carti, and Baby Keem. The festival runs from June 12th to 14th at SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview, Illinois. We can't wait to see what's next for North West and the rest of the performers at this year's festival."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. Join us next time for more updates on the latest music trends and news."
